content.about: Burkina Faso is a landlocked country in West Africa. Its name means "land of upright people". It is known for mud-brick architecture and painted houses in Tiébélé. Ouagadougou hosts a big African film festival.

standout.text: Ouagadougou hosts FESPACO, Africa's largest film festival.

didYouKnow: Tiébélé's houses are painted with geometric patterns.
FESPACO is held every two years.
Burkina Faso is a major cotton producer.
